worldcombat.skill.firefang.summary: Bite through and press a flame into the wound: the bite deals damage and may set the target burning, piercing immunity so even a fire-proof body catches it; a hard bite can leave the target flinching. Searing style burns deeper, quick-bite style hits harder.
worldcombat.skill.firefang.use.0: Bite and set a target burning at close range
worldcombat.skill.firefang.use.1: Burn a fire-proof or immune body
worldcombat.skill.firefang.use.2: Wince the target and cut off what it is doing
worldcombat.skill.firefang.description.0: The bite deals about %1$s contact and bite damage over a fang radius of %2$s blocks; the target's defence, type matchup and crits are settled on impact.
worldcombat.skill.firefang.description.1: A hit has a %1$s chance to press the flame into the wound, burning for %2$s; while burning, the target loses about 1/16 of its max health (at least 1) every 5 seconds and deals half physical damage.
worldcombat.skill.firefang.description.2: The burn opens a %1$s pierce window first: during it the burn ignores type and ability immunity, so even a fire body catches.
worldcombat.skill.firefang.description.3: A hit has a %1$s chance to make the target flinch for %2$s, interrupting an interruptible action; while flinching it cannot start new moves or ordinary attacks.
worldcombat.skill.firefang.sear.on: Searing style: easier and longer burns with a longer pierce window, but a lighter bite and a longer wind-up and cooldown.
worldcombat.skill.firefang.sear.off: Quick-bite style: a heavier bite and a faster cycle, but the flame is harder to catch and the pierce window is shorter.
worldcombat.skill.firefang.timing: Range %1$s blocks; wind-up %2$s s, recovery %3$s s, cooldown %4$s s, costing %5$s PP.
worldcombat.skill.firefang.growth.0: From level %1$s the bite power rises to %2$s.
worldcombat.skill.firefang.growth.1: From level %1$s the bite power rises to %2$s and the burn chance to %3$s.
worldcombat.skill.firefang.preference.se: On: burn chance +12%%, burn duration x1.2, pierce window +15 ticks, but bite power x0.90, wind-up +2 ticks and cooldown +4 ticks, for burning through fire types. Off (quick bite): a heavier bite and a faster cycle, but the flame is harder to catch.
worldcombat.skill.firefang.preference.ai: Beyond this distance the user closes in first. The fire fang reach is short, so a large value often still cannot connect.
On: targets that are not already burning rank first, so the pierce is not wasted; a fire-type target ranks higher still. Off: all targets rank the same.
